verdict.rationale: Runway documents its own natural-language surfaces. It lists an 'Agentic creative collaborator' as a plan feature, ships a first-party Runway MCP to drive it from Claude/ChatGPT, offers a Dev MCP for Cursor/Claude Code/Codex, and supports text-prompted generation. Each is only a one-line mention, so how far natural language can operate the product beyond prompting generations is unproven. Missing for 10: documentation of what the agentic collaborator can actually do (editing, project management, workflow control via commands), MCP tool coverage details, and hands-on or independent corroboration of natural-language operation.
